title.narrative: Partner Capacity Building- Organisational Strategic plan.

description.narrative: In 2014, CAFOD Mano River team conducted an organizational assessment for all its partners and developed capacity building plan to run through a couple of years. The assessment averred that most Local NGOs are grappling with several structural issues including lack of strategic development plan and other work place policies. Therefore, these organisations struggle to present their visions and programme directions when meeting donors for programme interventions. Furthermore the assessment report shows that the issues are inherent with faith-based institutions because of the linkage with the overall development agenda of the parent organization. It is based on the afore-mentioned challenges and desire to support partner organisations in Liberia and Sierra Leone that CAFOD Mano River office decided to recruit a consultant to support the partners to develop clear strategic direction/plan for two (2) organisations in Liberia
